bio:
Fortunato Ferlaino was baptized at San Mango d'Aquino on 6 March 1822, the son of Nicola Ferlaino and Agata Moraca; his godfather came from the neighbouring village of Conflenti. On 15 June 1851 he married Rosa (Tommasina) Moraca, daughter of the late Francesco Moraca and Francesca Orlando.

Their children were Gennaro (1855), Raffaela (1858), Marianna (1865), Giuseppe Antonio (1868), a first Leopoldo (1870, who died at five months) and John's ancestor Leopoldo (1871). Fortunato outlived his wife and lived to see his son leave for Pennsylvania. He died on 28 April 1901 and was buried at San Mango, the burial record giving his age as 82. He was John's 3rd-great-grandfather.
